paragraphs: Please consider our original research manuscript, “A Synthetic Study of Assessment Feedback,” for publication in the Fictional Journal of Learning Science.
Using a fully synthetic dataset, the study tests whether structured feedback improves calibration while preserving appropriate uncertainty.
The manuscript is original, is not under consideration elsewhere, and has been approved by all authors.
selected_story_angle: Structured feedback improves calibration without overstating certainty.
journal_conversation: The fictional journal's synthetic readership is discussing trustworthy feedback design.
